name: Glyphic Letter
summary: A summons reaches novice human mages in Northshire Valley from Marshal McBride. Khelden Bremen calls promising spellcasters to Northshire Abbey to begin their arcane tutelage.

sections.title: A Summons to the Arcane
sections.body: Marshal McBride gives the rune-marked letter to an aspiring apprentice who has proved capable by helping him against local vermin. Khelden Bremen, the mage trainer at Northshire, wrote it. He watches new recruits arrive at the abbey, looking for magical discipline and talent.

sections.title: The Weight of Wizardry
sections.body: Northshire Abbey has long sheltered the Holy Light. Yet Stormwind's dangers call for practitioners of every discipline. The letter brings you upstairs to Khelden Bremen, who offers no easy praise. He warns that mastering arcane power means defying nature's limits. Such power earns profound respect and deep fear from ordinary folk.

faq.answer: Marshal McBride gives the letter to newly arrived mages outside Northshire Abbey after they help clear nearby kobold vermin.
Khelden Bremen, the mage trainer in Northshire Abbey's upper chambers, wrote and sealed the letter.

faq.q: Where do I find Khelden Bremen?
faq.answer: Enter Northshire Abbey behind Marshal McBride. Take the left hallway, then climb the stairs. Khelden waits in the rear chambers to teach.

faq.q: Why is the mage trainer located in an abbey?
aliases: why are mages in northshire abbey
faq.answer: Northshire Abbey is a holy sanctuary, yet Stormwind uses the valley to train defenders in every discipline. Arcane tutors work there alongside clerics and marshals.

faq.q: What happens after turning in the letter?
faq.answer: Khelden Bremen accepts you as his student. He welcomes your resolve to wield the arcane despite its dangers and offers direct access to basic spell training.

faq.q: Why does Khelden warn that mages will be feared?
faq.answer: Arcane magic can bend reality and is volatile. Khelden warns that the pursuit of supreme knowledge crosses boundaries ordinary folk find deeply unsettling.

angles.text: As a mage, you begin your recognized apprenticeship in Stormwind's arcane arts under Khelden Bremen.
As a human, you carry Northshire's legacy of arcane magic. It reaches back to Dalaran's first human arcanists and the Kirin Tor, and continues in the Kingdom of Stormwind.
